102: Rav Ashi says - this baraita is dealing with one who is giving a gift, and it is entirely one [formulation] and not written as either-or; rather, he wrote as follows: "my field is sold and given to you" in order to enhance his power, so that if a creditor of the giver collects from him [i.e., from the gifted field], [the beneficiary] can return to [the giver] and claim the money specified [in the document].
